capture.zh: 瞭望舱【热门精灵推荐】第三页可前往新场景冰晶奇宫挑战伊索里；打败获得伊索的精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 飞行/超能系克制：帕罗狄亚带禁制领域与大招为主力，斯加尔卡或斯普林特自杀辅助；尽量在它1/4血以上时打出大伤害。

engine_notes: stages_unclearable for def/spd only: normal 消强 removes its atk boost but not the double-defence boost (4399 2012-12-10 and 聚侠 2012-12-07: 正常消强化技能不可消除双防强化). 帕罗狄亚's 禁制领域, the guides' answer, still works: it disables boosts for 5 turns (seer_eff_156) instead of clearing them.
foe_cannot_boost: the player's pets cannot raise their stat stages during this fight (我方不能强化).
Below 1/4 HP its attack damage doubles.
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
Control skills and DoT statuses do not work (immune_status).

skills: species 1453's last four at or below Lv100. 4399 battle screenshots (2012-12-07) show 巨力猛爪击 and 狂战之力, and 4399 2012-12-10 reports doubled damage below 1/4 HP (巨力猛爪击's effect); 威猛战气 and 无畏勇者 are not named.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 聚侠 2012-12-07: 100级, 10000体力, 天生攻击/防御/特防+2, 1/4以下伤害翻倍, 我方不能强化.
